prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high overall, though several major winning changes (such as sign_in redesign in r6, choose_path redesign in r10, adoption new_flow in r12 and r18, finish redesign in r15 and r18, and adoption redesign in r16) were underpredicted.
Sign-in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 11 tests (rounds 1, 7, and 15), while the remaining 8 showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 2 of 11 tests (rounds 13 and 14), while the remaining 9 showed no clear effect.
Adoption new_flow changes were helpful, winning 2 of 4 tests (rounds 12 and 18), though round 8 hurt performance and round 17 showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes consistently failed to produce positive results, showing no clear effect or hurting performance across all 3 tests with zero wins.
Redesigns across adoption, finish, choose_path, and sign-in categories frequently hurt performance or showed no clear effect despite occasional wins, while evidence remains thin or mixed for single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Sync Restore Safeguard Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen using a spotlight layout that highlights pet data preservation and cloud sync restoration. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Adoption Trait Selection Flow: Introduce a guided multi-step trait selection flow on the pick_friend screen using interactive choice cards. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (76.2%) and a high mean duration (1017s).)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Start Controls Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding summary screen demonstrating desktop pet interactions and mouse controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Journey Path Selection Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen with a spotlight layout highlighting path options clearly. (why: The choose_path screen shows a mean completion time of 514s, indicating decision inertia.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Add a clear safeguard hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that logging in restores existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost pets when signing in with existing accounts.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Spawn Wait Info: Add desktop engine initialization status info to the waiting screen with a ready notification toggle. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets do not show on desktop or the app stalls before rendering.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Pet Adoption Seal Incentive: Add an official registration badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate pet adoption. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off in onboarding (76.2% conversion rate).)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Notification: Include a tip carousel component on home_intro explaining shortcut controls and hide options. (why: Multiple support emails cite confusion around desktop pet controls and feature behavior after setup.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Journey Choice Fast Start Copy: Update the headline and body copy on choose_path to clearly contrast instant pre-made vs custom pet options. (why: Mean time of 514s on choose_path points to hesitation between creation options.)
9: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Photo Upload Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen with a split layout pairing instructions alongside the upload area. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual artifacts.)
